posts.name: captaingoldfish
posts.cooked:
Here is an post-con report for those who are interested.  I ran this event 3 times and everyone seemed to have a blast.

 

This event took our heroes from the streets of Megalopolis, to the Ruins of Atlantis, and ended up on Insula Primalis, where they faced Citizen Dawn.

 

Everyone seems to love Tachyon, as she was the only hero to be picked at all three events.  She was also responsible for defeating the krakken in two of the three events.  After the heroes learned there was simply no way to beat the beast down, she used her super speed to get the Krakken to attack her and then using here lightning fast agility and relexes to make the giant beast tie its tentacles into knots, taking it out of the fight.

 

Game session two was awesome with Unity riding on the back of her massive T-Rex bot, eating and stomping on Citizens of the Sun minions.

 

Session one featured the Wraith, who was instrumental in defeating the forces attacking the city while never even leaving her base.  She coordinated via communications satellites, and used her tech skills to cause havoc with the Citizens of the Sun gadgets and vehicles, making it easier for the rest of the team to take them out.

 

Thanks to all who participated.  I look forward to running this again in the future and I have already started on a new event.

 

Stay tuned all...  :)

I wish my memory was a bit better, but running multiple demos at the booth for four days has made it all a blur.

 

Here is a breakdown of the hero groups for the three sessions I ran:

 

Session 1:  Tachyon, Wraith, Expatriette, Argent Adept, plus two more.  I cant remeber who.  Perhaps Ninjetticat can refresh my memory, as he showed up for this and there was a no show so he got into some Sentinels action.  I remember him, but I can't for the life of me remember who he played.  Feel free to remind me and possibly remeber who the other hero was as well.

 

Session 2:  Tachyon, Omnitron-X, Unity, Tempest, and again two others that escape me at the moment.

 

Session 3: Tachyon, Bunker, Omnitron-X, Young Legacy, Unity, and Chrono-Ranger.

 

All three sessions featured Ra and Fanatic.  They were unlockable character during the event, and the players took advantage of their awesomeness each session.

The Games on Demand sessions were not run by me, they were run by a friend of mine, Tim.  He was running all sorts of great stuff at games on demand and was planning on doing Marvel Heroic so he offered to run Sentinels if I gave him the materials, which of course I did.

 

The materials (event book) are not currently available.  I need to do a bunch of editing before I am comfortable putting it anywhere.  I also need to scale up the villains a little.  I found that they were not as challenging as I had hoped they would be for the heroes.  In groups they are fine, but one on one they were out classed.

 

Once I finish polishing everything up, I will check with the GtG guys, and if they don't have a problem with it, I will make everything available to all.

 

I am glad you enjoyed it, and will be sure to let Tim know you had a good time.

Whoops, I took WAY too long to see if there was post-Con follow up on this thread!

The other two heroes at the first session were my Legacy (trapping SCUBA-gear citizens under the ripped-off top of the pyramid, and saving the Megalopolis Public Library from fiery doom in the opening scene) and Expatriette's buddy Nightmist, who phased her mist arm into the mystic energy stored in the sub and actually gave the Kraken a blast it could feel, as I recall.

"Citizens Rise" was a fantastically well-done event, the layers of plot and interweaving of the details all functioning beautifully within the setting of SotM. I look forward to playing another one, if you do indeed continue! And if the Sentinels MHP sheets end up available for all, that would also be an amazing thing. Also, hats off to you once again on the production values of everything the players could see. The GM side of the screen may have been as rough as you claim, but the players' side looked phenomianl. Congrats!
